Tests QUIC packet metadata compare and ACK range handling under reordering.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for QUIC packet metadata tracking and ACK range processing. It boots the QUIC test environment, creates a QUIC workspace and packet metadata pool, then fills a connection tracker with synthetic sent packet metadata. It also checks `fd_quic_pkt_meta_cmp` with fixed key values to verify the compare order for packet number, type, and stream ID.

The main test logic is in [`test_adversarial_ack`](<#test_adversarial_ack>), which calls `fd_quic_process_ack_range` under three patterns: an adversarial pattern, a reordered pattern, and a no-reordering pattern. Each pattern drains the tracked sent packet metadata while measuring elapsed time and logging the result. The file uses `fd_quic_pkt_meta_ds` and related tracker APIs as internal test targets, so it acts as a focused performance and correctness test for ACK handling in the QUIC implementation.
